document.title: Digest reads generated markers; skill names citation, shared helper, and pin rules in the steps
document.summary: Two stories: the digest classes a file generated when the first lines of its head blob say so, and the skill states three grouping and citation rules as actions in steps 3 and 4.
document.why: The census of graded eval runs blamed a generated schema folded into a docs group, and three recurring majors whose rules lived only in reference sections ([PR #153](source:s1)).

sources.label: PR #153
sources.title: Digest reads generated markers; skill names citation, shared helper, and pin rules in the steps
sources.gist: Content marker for generated files in the digest; three skill rules moved into the steps. Starship and this repo keep JSON schemas with no marker, so they stay logic.

lookFor: The [PR body](source:s1) says starship's `.github/config-schema.json` and this repo's `src/schema/review.schema.json` still digest as logic; nothing in the diff reads `.gitattributes` or JSON content, so that stays true at head.
The [PR body](source:s1) says the skill rules are unmeasured. The diff changes no eval case or grader, so no check in this repo covers the three new sentences.

parts.name: generated marker
parts.summary: readDiff flags a file whose head blob carries a codegen marker, and the digest classes it generated ahead of its path.

parts.name: skill rules
parts.summary: Steps 3 and 4 of the skill name the citation, shared helper, and version pin rules with their own Done clauses.

groups.title: readDiff flags generated files
groups.why: A path pattern missed files that say they are generated in a header comment ([PR #153](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `generatedPaths` in `generated.ts` runs one `git grep` at head over the changed files, and `markGenerated` in `diff.ts` sets the new `generated` field on each `DiffFile` whose first 20 lines hold a marker.
lookFor: Subtle: `generated.ts` flags itself. Its regex line holds `@generated` inside the first 20 lines, so this PR's own digest lists the file as generated.

Every `readDiff` call now spawns one more git process, `git grep` at head over every non-deleted text file, including the server's live reads. `allowFail` swallows the exit 1 of no match, and any other grep failure with it; the file set is then empty and every file stays unflagged.
A marker past line 20 does not count: `late.ts` in the test has the marker after 30 license lines and stays unflagged.

groups.title: The digest classes a flagged file generated
groups.why: The flag has to reach the draft `mechanical` group, which the digest kind decides ([PR #153](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `classifyKind` in `digest.ts` returns `generated` for a flagged file right after the rename and copy checks, so the flag wins over the test and docs path classes.
lookFor: A generated `.md` or a file under `tests/` with a marker now lands in the draft `mechanical` group; before, its path class won.

groups.title: Three rules as step actions
groups.why: A rule that lives only in a reference section stops firing for a busy step list; naming it in the step with its own Done brought lookFor, parts, and summaries back ([PR #153](source:s1)).
groups.summary: Step 3 gives the dependency policy story a concrete example, step 4 turns the citation rule into a find-the-sentence action with a Done clause and places shared helpers in the foundation group, and the foundation bullet in Grouping rules says the same; `.agents/skills/comprehende/SKILL.md` is the synced copy.

commits.subject: Digest: a generated marker is a statement about the file, not a mention
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
"AI-generated code changes" in a skill description matched the loose
"generated code" form. The marker now takes "file is generated" and a
line that starts "Generated by" or "Generated file", beside the
@generated, DO NOT EDIT, and auto-generated forms.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Skill: citation, shared helper, and version pin rules as actions in the steps
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The census of 133 graded runs showed three recurring majors: a why or lookFor
that cites a source for what it does not say, a helper several groups call
kept in the story that added it, and exact-to-range version bumps left in a
harness group. Step 4 now names the citation as an action with its own Done,
the step 4 Done places shared helpers in the foundation group, and step 3
names the pin change as a concrete example of a dependency policy story.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Digest: a file whose head blob says it is generated is generated
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Codegen tools write a marker in the first lines: @generated, DO NOT EDIT,
automatically generated, Code generated by. readDiff reads those lines with
one git grep over the changed files at head and flags the file; the digest
classes it generated ahead of its path. A prose mention of generation, or a
marker past line 20, does not count.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
